title: Establishing Crops: Direct Sowing and Transplanting
summary: Seedbed preparation, broadfork aeration, leveling, regular row sowing, and stress-free transplanting for young plants.

pages.title: 10 m
pages.text:
BED N° 3 BED N° 4 BED N° 5 OKRA CARROTS PEANUT MARCH 13 MARCH 13 MARCH 13 75 cm Before sowing or transplanting, it is essential to properly prepare the garden beds. With beds that are

well-aerated, leveled, and labeled, you will:

- Promote optimal plant growth.
- Simplify plot organization.

Here, we are working on **permanent garden beds** that are **10 meters long** and **75 cm wide**.

pages.title: STEP 1: HOW TO PROPERLY AERAT THE BED?
pages.text: STEP 1: HOW TO PROPERLY AERAT THE BED?
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour ÉTAPE 1 : COMMENT BIEN AÉRER LA PLANCHE ?

pages.title: Check that the bed is well aerated: the soil should be soft and loose.
pages.text: If the soil is compacted, use a broadfork, pushing it in deeply, to aerate the soil.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Vérifiez que la planche soit bien aérée : le sol doit être souple et meuble.

pages.title: Using a broadfork is a deep soil cultivation without turning it over. This allows for:
pages.text:
- the incorporation of compost into the bed.

- better water penetration.

- the deep development of roots.

pages.title: STEP 2: HOW TO PROPERLY LEVEL THE BED?
pages.text: STEP 2: HOW TO PROPERLY LEVEL THE BED?
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour ÉTAPE 2 : COMMENT BIEN NIVELER LA PLANCHE ?

pages.title: Use a fine rake to level the bed and remove large debris such as stones, plant debris, plastics...
pages.text: This allows for an even distribution of water across the bed, which promotes uniform crop development.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Passez le râteau fin pour niveler la planche et enlever les gros débris comme les pierres, les débris végétaux, les plastiques...

pages.title: STEP 3: HOW TO LABEL YOUR BED?
pages.text: STEP 3: HOW TO LABEL YOUR BED?
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour ÉTAPE 3 : COMMENT ÉTIQUETER VOTRE PLANCHE ?

pages.text:
👍 To ensure proper monitoring of your crops, each bed must be clearly identified with a label.

Prepare the label:

- Use available materials, such as pieces of wood, metal, or plastic plates.

- Write the information using a marker resistant to water and sunlight.

- You can also use a pencil, or engrave the information to prevent it from fading.

pages.title: BOARD N° 4
pages.text:
MARCH 13 CARROTS

Indicate the following information on the label:

Board number: for example, number from 1 to 10 for a plot with 10 boards.

Planting date Crop name and variety.

pages.title: BOARD N° 4
pages.text: MARCH 13 CARROTS Place the label at the beginning of the board.
